scope: Feature branch 024-shared-editing-pages vs origin/main (git diff origin/main...HEAD, head 0489baf6): source, templates, tests and docs. Files under specs/ read as the yardstick, not reviewed as code. Phase 1 correctness and spec compliance, then the security lens, then the documentation pass.

findings.claim: A sample's delete page names a related sample that sits in a dataset the viewer holds no level on. The page withholds the names of blocking measurements the viewer may not see (split_protected), but the list of rows that go with a sample is drawn unfiltered, and a sample relationship row prints both samples' names.
findings.evidence: fairdm/core/editing.py:434-452: DeleteRecord.get_context_data replaces `related_objects` with counts only when `model in {Project, Dataset}` (line 450). For a sample or measurement it keeps what MVPDeleteView.get_context_data built: up to 25 instances per model, each drawn with str(). fairdm/core/sample/models.py:428-430: SampleRelation.__str__ returns f"{self.source} {self.type} {self.target}". SampleRelation.source and .target both cascade (models.py:412, 418), so the row is in the collector's data. The sample overview filters the same relations through Sample.visible_to (fairdm/core/sample/plugins.py:213, 253), so the delete page shows what the record's own page hides. Observed against a throwaway test database: the delete page of sample 'Mine' answered 200 and its body contained 'SecretSampleName'; context related_objects was [('Samples', ['Mine']), ('Sample Relationships', ['Mine child_of SecretSampleName'])]; the overview of 'Mine' for the same person did not contain 'SecretSampleName'. The only test of this listing, tests/test_core/test_editing.py:1540 test_a_sample_and_a_measurement_list_the_rows_that_go_with_them, reads that one date row is in the list and never looks for a row naming another record.
findings.reproduction: Dataset A (private), person P at the manage level on A. Sample 'Mine' in A. Dataset B (private, P holds nothing on it) with sample 'SecretSampleName'. SampleRelation(source=Mine, target=SecretSampleName, type='child_of'). As P, GET reverse('sample:delete', uuid=Mine.uuid). The page lists 'Mine child_of SecretSampleName'. The same holds with the hidden sample as source.
findings.suggested_fix: In DeleteRecord.get_context_data, for a sample, drop from `related_objects` every SampleRelation whose source or target is not in Sample.objects.visible_to(self.request.user), and add how many were dropped to the count the page already shows for unlisted records. Add a test beside test_a_sample_with_measurements_names_those_the_viewer_may_see_and_counts_the_rest that asserts the hidden sample's name and uuid are absent from the page.

findings.claim: The breaking changes in this branch have no section in the migration guide, which the constitution requires for a breaking change.
findings.evidence: CONSTITUTION.md:70: 'Breaking changes MUST include a migration guide with concrete, step-by-step instructions.' docs/more/migration-guides.md carries a section per earlier breaking feature ('022 - Access to a record is a level on its contribution', '005 — The sample record'). The diff touches that file only to reword three lines at 265-267 and adds no section. The branch removes the URL names project:overview-update, project:overview-descriptions, project:overview-delete, the same three on dataset, and sample:basic-information; the /update/ address on projects and datasets; UpdatePlugin, DeletePlugin and the module fairdm.contrib.generic.plugins (KeywordsPlugin, DescriptionsPlugin, KeyDatesPlugin); the templates plugins/descriptions.html, plugins/key-dates.html and dataset/plugins/update.html; the `urls` and `can_edit` keys of the sample overview context and `urls.delete`, `directory` and `crud_views` on the project and dataset overviews; and changes a 404 to a 403 for a signed-in viewer of a private project or dataset. The upgrade directions exist only as clauses spread over five CHANGELOG.md entries (lines 38-67).
findings.suggested_fix: Add one section to docs/more/migration-guides.md for this feature that lists, as steps: each removed URL name with the name to reverse instead; each removed class with what to build on; each removed template and context key with its replacement; that `dates-` and `identifiers-` rows are now posted to `key-dates` and `identifiers`; and that a template which drew its own Manage dropdown in `overview.actions` now fills `overview.manage`.

findings.claim: The project and dataset user guide pages name Manage menu entries that do not exist.
findings.evidence: docs/user-guide/project/about.md:23 and docs/user-guide/dataset/about.md:23 list an entry '**Edit keywords**'; docs/user-guide/project/update.md:42 and docs/user-guide/dataset/update.md:43 say 'Keywords have **Edit keywords**'. The entry is labelled 'Keywords' (fairdm/core/editing.py:319). docs/user-guide/project/about.md:29 lists '**Delete project**' and docs/user-guide/dataset/about.md:29 '**Delete dataset**'. The entry is labelled 'Delete' on every record type (fairdm/core/editing.py:396). The sample and measurement guide pages use the real labels (docs/user-guide/sample/keywords.md: 'as **Keywords**').
findings.suggested_fix: Change the four 'Edit keywords' mentions to 'Keywords' and the two 'Delete project' / 'Delete dataset' entries to 'Delete'.

findings.claim: A sample's or measurement's delete page lists the record itself among what goes with it.
findings.evidence: A registered type is a multi-table child of Sample or Measurement, so the collector reports the base row under the core model. MVPDeleteView._collect_deletion_data skips only `model is type(self.object)` (mvp/views/edit.py), and DeleteRecord.get_context_data (fairdm/core/editing.py:450) corrects the listing for projects and datasets alone. Observed: the delete page of RockSample 'Mine' had related_objects [('Samples', ['Mine']), ...]. FR-030 asks the page to say what else is removed.
findings.suggested_fix: For a sample or measurement, drop from `related_objects` the group whose instances are the record's own base row (same pk, class is the core model).

findings.claim: The project Manage menu lost its 'Manage contributors' entry and the changelog does not say so.
findings.evidence: fairdm/core/project/templates/project/project_detail.html: the diff removes `<c-menu.item label="Manage contributors" ... href="{{ urls.contributors }}" />`. tests/test_core/test_editing.py:600 test_the_project_menu_has_no_contributors_entry pins the removal. `grep -n "Manage contributors" CHANGELOG.md` returns nothing, and no Removed entry mentions it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line under Removed in CHANGELOG.md: the project Manage menu no longer carries a contributors entry, and the Contributors tab is where they are managed.

findings.claim: Three properties the pages hold are asserted by no test, so a later change could break them with the suite green: a row id from another record posted to key dates or identifiers, a POST that tries to move a sample or measurement, and a POST by an editor that tries to set the withheld parent or visibility.
findings.evidence: tests/test_core/test_editing.py: TestEditKeyDates and TestEditIdentifiers post only rows of the record itself. Line 702 test_the_page_offers_the_types_own_fields_with_their_values and line 760 test_visibility_is_offered_to_a_manager_only read `form.fields` on a GET and never post; line 760 does not look at `project` on a dataset or `owner` on a project. No test covers the delete page of a dataset or project blocked by a measurement in another dataset, which docs/portal-development/record-editing-pages.md:191 and docs/user-guide/project/delete.md describe. Probed against a throwaway test database, the code holds in each case: posting another project's and another sample's date row id with a new value and then with DELETE left the row unchanged and stored; a manager posting `dataset` to sample:edit and `dataset` plus `sample` to measurement:edit moved nothing; an editor posting `project` and `visibility` to dataset:edit changed neither; a visitor's POST to all four delete pages answered 302 and deleted nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one test for each: a foreign row id posted to key-dates leaves that row unchanged; a manager's POST with `dataset` (and `sample`) to the edit page of a sample and a measurement leaves both unchanged; an editor's POST with `project` and `visibility` to dataset:edit leaves both unchanged.

findings.claim: Drawing the Manage menu asks the overview's visibility check once per page, six times per overview render.
findings.evidence: fairdm/core/editing.py:146: RecordEditingPage.verdict calls can_open(cls.overview_for(record), request, record) and manage_menu (line 544-553) calls verdict for each of the six pages. On a sample or measurement the check is a `visible_to(...).filter(pk=...).exists()` query that nothing memoises (fairdm/core/plugins.py:476-479). Measured for a manager: manage_menu(request, record) issued 10 queries on a sample, 10 on a measurement and 16 on a project.
findings.suggested_fix: Evaluate the overview check once in manage_menu and hand the answer to each page's verdict, or keep it on the request beside the permission memo that has_perm already uses.

findings.claim: Two helpers lost their only caller in this branch and were left behind.
findings.evidence: fairdm/core/utils.py:17 documentation_link: its one caller on origin/main was fairdm/core/sample/plugins.py:361 (the removed sample Keywords plugin); no reference remains in fairdm, demo, tests or docs. fairdm/contrib/generic/forms.py:139 DateForm: its one caller on origin/main was fairdm/contrib/generic/plugins.py:64 (the removed KeyDatesPlugin); no reference remains. CoreInlineFormset (forms.py:101) is now reached only from DescriptionInline and Description2Inline (forms.py:288, 318), which nothing referenced before this branch either.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove documentation_link and DateForm, or record why they stay. The removal of the classes that were already unreferenced is a separate decision.

notes: Access rule walked for a visitor, a signed-in person with no level, view, edit and manage levels, each shipped portal role and direct model-level grants, on public and private records of all four types, GET and POST. No gain found. Data Curator opens edit and delete on private records of all four types; the other three roles get 404. A direct model-level change or delete grant alone gets 404 on a private record of every type, as decision D2 records.

Outside this diff: a person holding only a direct model-level dataset.change_dataset gets 404 on a private dataset's own page but 200 on the overview of its samples and measurements, because Sample and Measurement visible_to admit that grant. The editing pages inherit this through the overview check and add nothing to it.

EditDetails.get_form_kwargs passes the request only when the form's constructor names a `request` parameter. SampleFormMixin and MeasurementFormMixin take it through **kwargs, so forms built on them get no request on this page. Nothing reads it today because `dataset` and `sample` are removed from the form.
